run.description: Run button label: starts the fiddle in Electron.

stop.description: Run button label while the fiddle runs: stops it.

starting.description: Run button label and status while Electron starts.

downloadingPercent.description: Run button label while the chosen Electron version downloads. {{percent}} is 0 to 100.

checking.description: Run button label and status while Fiddle checks that the fiddle can run (trust, version, package manager).

unzipping.description: Run button label and status while the downloaded Electron version is unzipped.

installingModules.description: Run button label and status while npm or yarn installs the fiddle's modules.

announceChecking.description: Screen reader announcement while Fiddle checks that the fiddle can run.

announceUnzipping.description: Screen reader announcement while the downloaded Electron version is unzipped.

announceInstalling.description: Screen reader announcement while the fiddle's modules install.

announceReady.description: Screen reader announcement when the fiddle can be run.

announceStarting.description: Screen reader announcement while Electron starts.

announceDownloading.description: Screen reader announcement when the Electron version starts downloading before a run.

announceRunning.description: Screen reader announcement once the fiddle runs. {{version}} is the Electron version, e.g. 43.0.0.

console.description: Title of the output console pane.

consoleOutput.description: Accessible name of the list of console lines.

filterAll.description: Console filter: show output from every process.

filterMain.description: Console filter: show only the main process's output.

filterRenderer.description: Console filter: show only renderer processes' output.

filterProcess.description: Accessible name of the console's process filter.

filterOutput.description: Placeholder of the console's text filter field.

clearConsole.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the console's clear button.

running.description: Status pill shown while the fiddle runs, in the console bar and status bar.

ready.description: Status bar text when no fiddle is running.

processFiddle.description: Console process column for messages from Electron Fiddle itself.

processMain.description: Console process column for output from the fiddle's main process.

processRenderer.description: Console process column for output from the fiddle's web pages.

revealLocation.description: Accessible name of an error location link in the console, e.g. 'Go to renderer.js:4'.

newError.description: Polite screen reader announcement of a new runtime error.

electronVersion.description: A version in the version picker and status bar, e.g. 'Electron 43.0.0'.

versionPicker.description: Accessible name of the version picker.

groupLocal.description: Version picker and manager group of the user's own Electron builds.

groupStable.description: Version picker group of stable releases.

groupPrerelease.description: Version picker group of beta, alpha and nightly releases.

hintLatest.description: Hint beside the newest stable version in the version picker. Lowercase by design.

hintBeta.description: Hint beside a beta or alpha version in the version picker. Lowercase by design.

hintNightly.description: Hint beside a nightly version in the version picker. Lowercase by design.

filterVersions.description: Placeholder of the version manager's filter field.

channelStable.description: Version manager checkbox: show stable releases.

channelBeta.description: Version manager checkbox: show beta and alpha releases.

channelNightly.description: Version manager checkbox: show nightly releases.

downloadedOnly.description: Version manager checkbox: show only downloaded versions.

downloadAll.description: Version manager button that downloads every version in the list, one at a time.

stopDownloads.description: Version manager button that stops 'Download all'.

deleteAll.description: Version manager button that deletes every downloaded version and local build except the ones in use.

deleteAllTitle.description: Title of the confirmation before 'Delete all'.

deleteAllBody.message: Versions in use and their local builds are kept. You can download the others again later.
deleteAllBody.description: Body of the confirmation before 'Delete all'.

addLocalBuild.description: Version manager button that picks a folder with the user's own Electron build.

refreshReleases.description: Version manager button that fetches the latest release list.

columnAction.description: Version manager table column with the download or remove button.

stateInstalled.description: Install state: the version is ready to run.

stateDownloaded.description: Install state: the zip is downloaded but not unpacked yet.

stateMissing.description: Install state: the version isn't on this computer.

stateInstalling.description: Install state while the download is unpacked.

stateLocal.description: Status of a local build that is available.

stateLocalMissing.description: Status of a local build whose Electron binary is gone.

stateUnsupported.description: Status of a release that can't run on this OS or processor.

remove.description: Version manager row action that deletes a download or unregisters a local build.

truncated.message: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} versions. Filter to see more.
truncated.description: Note under the version manager table when the list is cut short.

bisectTitle.description: Title of the bisect dialog, which finds the Electron release that changed the fiddle's behavior.

bisectIntro.message: Pick a version where the fiddle works and a later one where it doesn't. Fiddle then narrows down the release that changed it.

bisectGoodVersion.description: Bisect dialog field: an earlier version where the fiddle works.

bisectBadVersion.description: Bisect dialog field: a later version where the fiddle doesn't work.

bisectStart.description: Bisect dialog button: bisect by hand, marking each version good or bad.

bisectAuto.description: Bisect dialog button: runs each version and treats exit code 0 as good.

bisectRangeInvalid.message: The good version must be older than the bad one.

bisectFailed.description: Title of the error toast when a bisect step, or starting a bisect, fails. The reason is shown under it.

cancel.description: Button that dismisses a dialog or stops the bisect.

bisectGood.description: Bisect control: the version being tested works.

bisectBad.description: Bisect control: the version being tested is broken.

bisectSkip.description: Bisect control: can't tell, try another version.

bisectTesting.description: Status bar text during a bisect. {{version}} is the version being tested.

bisectAutoRunning.description: Status bar text during an automatic bisect.

bisectDoneTitle.description: Title of the bisect result dialog.

bisectResult.message: The change happened between Electron {{good}} and {{bad}}.
bisectResult.description: Bisect result. {{good}} is the last good version, {{bad}} the first bad one.

openCompare.description: Bisect result button that opens the comparison of the two releases.
